Package neqsim.process.diagnostics

Class JointBalanceScreen

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.diagnostics.JointBalanceScreen
final class JointBalanceScreen extends Object
Joint bounded-error balance on an oriented network. One shared meter has one signed error in both balances. Residual paths solve the bounded-flow feasibility and the two candidate-rate extrema. Capacity and demand arithmetic uses the decimal representations of the supplied doubles, with no absolute solver cutoff. Returned rate endpoints are rounded to the nearest double. Upstream integration and data retain their input precision.

1.0
